senses.gloss: सहस्र- + अंशु सहस्र- + अंशु, m. the sun.

सहस्र- + अक्ष सहस्र- + अक्ष,
 I. adj. thousand-eyed.
 II. m. a name of Indra.
सह- + आरोग्य सह- + आरोग्य, adj. convalescent, well.
सह- + आसन सह- + आसन, n. sitting on the same seat.
सहज- + इतर सहज- + इतर, adj. not innate, accidental.
सह- + उटज सह- + उटज, m. A hut made of leaves, the residence of anchorites.
सह- + उदर सह- + उदर, m. a brother of whole blood.
सह- + कृत सह- + कृत, adj. assisted, Bhāṣāp. 65.
सह- + गमन सह- + गमन, n. 1. accompanying. 2. a woman's burning herself with her deceased husband.

सह- + चर सह- + चर,
 I. adj., f. री. 1. going with. 2. united, Pañc. 43, 4.
 II. m. 1. a companion, 2. a surety.
 III. m. and f. री, yellow Barleria.
 IV. f. री. 1. female acquaintance. 2. a wife.

सहचर सह-चर् + अ,
 I. m. A companion, Pañc. 243, 3; a friend, 43, 4.
 II. f. री, A companion, a wife, Vikr. d. 102.
सह- + चार सह- + चार, m. the concomitance of the major and middle term, Bhāṣāp. 136.
सहचार सहचार, i. e. सह-चर् + अ, m. The accompaniment of the middle term by the major, Bhāṣāp. 136.
सह- + चारिन् सह- + चारिन्, m., f. इणी, and n., a companion, an attendant.
सहचारिन् सह-चारिन्, m. A companion, a friend, Pañc. 43, 1 (परस्परम् अतीव, Very dear to each other).
सह-द्रोण सह-द्रोण, adj. with Droṇa.
सहस्र- + नेत्र सहस्र- + नेत्र, adj. possessed of a thousand eyes.
सह- + पथिन् सह- + पथिन्, m. a fellow-traveller, Rām. 3, 53, 3.
सहस्र-पाद् सहस्र-पाद्, adj. thousandfooted.
सह- + पान सह- + पान, n. drinking together.

सह- + पिण्ड सह- + पिण्ड (Man. 3, 248), and स-, m. a kinsman, especially one connected by the offering of the funeral cake to either or all of the manes of the father, grandfather, and great-grandfather, and their wives respectively, as sprung from them in directly collateral lines; the relationship stops with every fourth person. The following are enumerated as स-पिण्डस्: the son, son's son, and son's grandson; widow, daughter, and daughter's son; the father, the mother, the brother, brother's son, and brother's grandson; father's daughter's son; paternal grandfather; paternal grandmother; paternal grandfather's brother, brother's son, and grandson; and lastly, the great-grandfather's daughter's son. Other enumerations extend the connection of Sapiṇḍas to seven persons, both in an ascending or descending line; cf. Man. 2, 247; 3, 247.
सहस्र- + भृष्टि सहस्र- + भृष्टि, adj. having a thousand points (vb. हृष् + ति), Chr. 292, 9 = Rigv. i. 85, 9.
सह- + भोजन सह- + भोजन, n. eating with somebody, Lass. 18, 2.
सह- + मरण सह- + मरण, n. a widow's burning herself with her deceased husband.
सह- + मारीच सह- + मारीच, adj. With Mārīca, Rām. 3, 48, 8.

सह- + लक्ष्मण सह- + लक्ष्मण, adj. with Lakṣmaṇa, Rām. 3, 52, 2.
 2. A name.
सहज- + वत्सल सहज- + वत्सल, adj., f. ला, of inborn fondness, Hit. 87, 12.
शाहि शाहि m. The name of a dynasty, Rājat. 5, 154.
सहस्र- + संख्य सहस्र- + संख्य, f. a thousand, Kir. 5, 34.

1. सह् सह् (probably a combination of two originally different verbs, viz. सह्, ‘to conquer,’ cf. सहस्, and स-वह्, ‘to bear,’ cf. infin. सोढुम् = स-वोढुम्, ptcple. of the pf. pass. सोढ = स-ऊढ), i. 1, Ātm. (also Par.), and † i. 10, Par.
 1. To bear, Vikr. d. 135; Böhtl. Ind. Spr. 997 (Par.); to undergo, Man. 2, 227.
 2. To endure, Bhartṛ. 2, 30.
 3. To allow, Pañc. 135, 7 (Par.).
 4. To forbear (with gen.), Bhag. 11, 44.
 5. To be patient, to wait, Ragh. 5, 25.
 6. To be able to resist, to oppose, to conquer, Rām. 1, 22, 21.
 7. To stop, Rām. 2, 24, 27.
 8. To be able (with infin.), Hit. ii. d. 139.
 --Comp.
 --ptcple. of the pres. अ-सहमान, adj. Not able to endure, Pañc. 221, 1.
 --Ptcple. of the pf. pass. सोढ.
 1. Borne, endured.
 2. Patient, enduring. सहित, see s. v.
 --Ptcple. of the fut. pass. सह्य.
 1. Equal or adequate to, Pañc. ii. d. 200 (but cf. my transl. n. 907).
 2. Sweet, agreeable; see also s. v.
 --Comp.
 अ-सह्य, adj. 1. insupportable, Ṛt. 1, 10. 2. unconquerable, Ragh. 18, 24.
 --With the prep. अभि अभि, absol. अभिषह्य, Forcibly, Man. 8, 367.
 --With उद् उद्,
 1. To make an effort or exertion, Bhaṭṭ. 19, 16.
 2. To dare, Pañc. 22, 1; with acc., To dare to pursue, Nal. 4, 16.
 3. To be able (with infin. and dat. of an abstract noun), Rām. 3, 51, 17; MBh. 3, 16543 (परिभोगाय, To enjoy).
 --With अभ्युद् अभि-उद्, To be able, to wish, Ragh. 5, 22.
 --With प्रोद् प्र-उद्, [] Caus. To incite, to instigate, Rām. 2, 9, 46.
 --With समुद् सम्-उद्, Caus. To incite, MBh. 2, 1412.
 --With प्र प्र,
 1. To make an effort, Pañc. iii. d. 51.
 2. To endure, Utt. Rāmac. 148, 5; absolut. प्रसह्य, Violently, Man. 8, 235.
 3. To overpower, Rām. 2, 5, 7.
 4. To be able (with infin.), MBh. 1, 4842.
 --With अभिप्र अभि-प्र, To be able, Kir. 12, 18.
 --With प्रति प्रति, To sustain, Rām. 1, 37, 8.
 --With वि वि,
 1. To sustain, Ragh. 4, 49.
 2. To suffer, Rām. 2, 61, 4.
 3. To endure, Rām. 2, 12, 106.
 4. To be able to resist, MBh. 5, 2021.
 5. To determine.
 --Ptcple. of the fut. pass. विषह्य, Possible, Arj. 5, 9.
 --Comp.
 अ-, adj. not being able to be determined or ascertained, Man. 8, 265.
 दुर्विषह्य, i. e. दुस्-, adj., f. या, difficult to be sustained.
 --Cf. ἔχω, ἕξω, ἔσχον, ἐχυρός, σχέσις, ἰσχάνω, ὑπισχνέομαι, σχολή; see सहस् and सह्य.

† 2. सह् सह्, i. 4, Par.
 1. To bear.
 2. To satisfy.
 3. To delight.

1. सह सह् + अ,
 I. adj.
 1. Bearing, Bhartṛ. 2, 68.
 2. Suffering.
 3. Enduring, Pañc. iii. d. 178 (शीत-वात-आतप-, Enduring coldness, wind, and heat).
 4. Patient.
 5. Able, Vikr. 78, 10; Śiś. 9, 51.
 II. m. and n. Strength, power.
 III. m. The month Mārgaśīrṣa (November--December).
 IV. f. हा.
 1. The earth.
 2. The name of several plants.
 --Comp.

2. सह सह, i. e. स + धा (with ह् for ध् as often, and the final shortened, cf. त्र for त्रा, सध, ved.),
 1. adv. as former part of comp. words, With, united, common, like, complete (e. g. सहकारिन्).
 2. prep. With (with instr., Rām. 3, 55, 41; epic also with dat., Chr. 13, 15; with abl., Cāṇ. 105 in Berl. Monatsb. 1864, 413).
 --Cf. probably Lat. sŏdā + lis.
सहक सह् + अक, adj. Enduring, Nalod. 2, 14.

सहकार i. e.
 I. स-ह-कार, adj. Endowed with the letter ह, i. e. the vocative particle, i. e. calling, Nalod. 2, 14.
 II. 2. सह-कार, m. A fragrant sort of mango, Vikr. d. 25.
सहकारिता सहकारिता, i. e. सहकारिन् + ता, f. Co-operation, assistance.
सहकारिन् सह-कारिन्, adj., f. इणी, Co-operating, assisting, Bhāṣāp. 80.
सहकृत् सह-कृ + त्, and सहकृत्वन् सह-कृ + त्वन्, adj. sbst. Assisting, an assister.

सहज सह-ज,
 I. adj.
 1. Born or produced with, together, Johns. Sel. 16, 66.
 2. Innate, Indr. 4, 7.
 3. Natural, Hit. 87, 12; Pañc. 110, 15.
 II. m.
 1. A brother of whole blood.
 2. The natural state or disposition.
सहजन्या सह-जन्या (see जन्य), f. The name of an Apsaras, Vikr. 51, 4.

सहदेव सह-देव,
 I. m. The youngest of the five Pāṇḍava princes.
 II. f. वा and वी, The name of several plants, Pañc. 157, 23 (वी).
सहधर्म सह-धर्म, m. Community of duty.

सहधर्मचारिन् सहधर्म-चारिन्,
 I. m. A husband, Śāk. 111, 12.
 II. f. इणी, A legitimate wife, ib. 5; Utt. Rāmac. 85, 12.

सहधर्मिन् सहधर्मिन्, i. e. सहधर्म + इन्,
 I. adj.; f. इणी.
 1. Following the same law.
 2. Having same or like properties.
 II. f. इणी, A woman married according to the ritual of the Vedas.

सहन सह् + अन,
 I. adj. Enduring.
 II. n. Bearing, enduring.
 --Comp.

सहपांसुकिल सह-पांसु-किल (किल, Play, Hemac.), and सहपासुक्रीडन सह-पांसु-क्रीडन, adj. sbst. m. (properly, One who has played with another in the sand, i. e. in his childhood), a friend from childhood, Mālat. 151, 17 (-क्रीडन).

सहस् सह् + अस्,
 I. m.
 1. The month Mārgaśīrṣa (Nov.--Dec.).
 2. The winter season.
 II. n.
 1. ved. Victory, strength, Lass. 101, 10 = Rigv. vii. 16, 4; power.
 2. instr. सा, adv.
 a. Without consideration, precipitately, [] Hit. iv. d. 97; quickly, Rām. 3, 54, 9.
 b. On a sudden, Pañc. 222, 23; Śāk. d. 9; at once, Pañc. 182, 14; with (?), Johns. Sel. 46, 1 (perhaps corr. सह चाप्स्˚).
 3. Light.
 --Cf. Goth. sigis; A.S. sigor, sige.
सहस्य सहस् + य, m. The month Pauṣa (Dec.--Jan.), Pāṇ. iv. 4, 128.

सहस्र सहस्र, numeral, n. A thousand, Pañc. 130, 16.
 --Comp.

साहस्र साहस्र, i. e. सहस्र + अ,
 I. adj.
 1. Relating or belonging to a thousand.
 2. Bought with a thousand.
 3. Paid per thousand, as interest, duty.
 4. A thousandfold, a thousand times better, Man. 2, 85.
 II. m. An army or detachment, a thousand strong.
 III. n. An aggregate of many thousands.
 --Comp.

सहस्रकृत्वस् सहस्र-कृत्वस्, adv.
 1. A thousand times, Man. 2, 79.
 2. Repeatedly.

सहस्रतय सहस्र + तय,
 I. adj. Thousandfold.
 II. n. A thousand, Śiś. 9, 80.
सहस्रधा सहस्र + धा, adv. In a thousand ways, thousandfold, Kir. 5, 17; in a thousand pieces, Pañc. 190, 10.
सहस्रमीळ्ह सहस्र-मीऌह (ved. for मीढ, vb. मिह्), adj. Yielding a thousand treasures, Chr. 296, 10 = Rigv. i. 112, 10.

सहस्रशस् सहस्र + शस्, adv. By a thousand, or thousands, Pañc. i. d. 262; thousandfold.
 --Comp.

सहस्रिन् सहस्रिन्, i. e. सहस्र + इन्,
 I. adj., f. इणी.
 1. Having a thousand, Pañc. v. d. 69.
 2. Consisting of thousands, Chr. 291, 15 = Rigv. i. 64, 15.
 3. (A fine) amounting to a thousand. Man. 8, 276.
 II. m.
 1. A body of a thousand men.
 2. Commander or prefect of a thousand.
सहस्वन्त् सहस् + वन्त्, adj., f. वति. [] Powerful, Lass. 99, 2 = Rigv. v. 9, 7 (ved. voc. ˚वस्).

सहाय सहाय, probably सह-इ + अ, m.
 1. A companion, Pañc. 221, 22.
 2. An adherent.
 3. A helper, Lass. 52, 1.
 4. An ally, Daśak. in Chr. 201, 1.
 5. The ruddy goose, Anas casarca.
 6. A sort of drug and perfume.
 --Comp.

साहाय्य साहाय्य, i. e. सहाय + य, n.
 1. Friendship.
 2. Alliance.
 3. Help. Pañc. ii. d. 13.
ऽसहायक -सहाय + क, instead of सहाय, at the end of a comp. adj., in नारयण-, Accompanied by Nārāyaṇa, Johns. Sel. 90, 29.
साहायक साहायक, i. e. सहाय + क (? perhaps it is to be read साकाय्यक), n. Assistance, Rājat. 5, 307.

सहायता सहाय + ता, f., and सहायत्व सहाय + त्व, n.
 1. A multitude of companions.
 2. Companionship, union, Pañc. 59, 10 (त्व).
 3. Help, Pañc. 154, 17 (त्व).

सहायवन्त् सहाय + वन्त्, adj., f. वती,
 1. Having a companion, Pañc. i. d. 97; Hit. iv. d. 18 (‘in the true sense of the word’).
 2. Assisted, befriended.
 --Comp.

सहित सहित, i. e. 2. सह + इत, adj.
 1. Accompanied by; at the end of comp. words, With, Hit. 61, 4.
 2. With (with instr.), Chr. 23, 32.
 3. Associated, Chr. 62, 52. pl. All, Lass. 2. ed. 61, 30.
 --Comp.

सहिष्णु सह् + इष्णु, adj.
 1. Able to support, Śāk. d. 37.
 2. Patient, Kir. 2, 50; [] resigned.
 --Comp.

सहिष्णुता सहिष्णु + ता, f.
 1. Ability to support, Vedāntas. in Chr. 203, 17.
 2. Patience, resignation.
 --Comp.

सहुरि सह् + उरि,
 I. m. The sun.
 II. f. The earth.

सहोढ सहोढ, i. e. सह-ऊढ (vb. वह्), m.
 1. The son of a pregnant bride, Man. 9, 160.
 2. A thief caught with stolen property upon him.
सहोर सहोर, i. e. probably सह + वन् + अ, with र् for न्, adj. Good, excellent.

सह्य सह्य,
 A. See सह्.
 B. i. e. सह + य,
 I. adj. Powerful, strong.
 II. n.
 1. Health, convalescence.
 2. Assistance, Rām. 6, 3, 26.
 C. m. The name of a range of mountains, Kir. 18, 5.
 --Cf. perhaps σαο and σω in σαώτερος, σῶος, σωτήρ, σώζω, σῶκος; Lat. sanus, but questionable on account of A.S. sund; O.H.G. ga-sunt (perhaps = सह + वन्त्).
साहचर्य साहचर्य, i. e. सह-चर + य, n. Company, association, congregation, Mālat. 6, 2.

साहस साहस, i. e. सहस् + अ, n. (and m., Man. 8, 138),
 1. Violence, Man. 8, 345.
 2. Oppression, cruelty, Śiś. 8, 59.
 3. Punishment, Man. 8, 120.
 4. Rape, ravishment.
 5. Hatred.
 6. Boldness, daring, Hit. ii. d. 3; Pañc. 135, 8; courage, Mālat. 75, 12.
 7. Rashness, Hit. iii. d. 115; Hit. 100, 3.
 8. Suicide, Pañc. 135, 6; Daśak. in Chr. 189, 7.
 --Comp.
स- + हास स- + हास, adj. smiling, Lass. 66, 5; ˚सम्, adv. scornfully, Utt. Rāmac. 136, 1.

साहसिक साहसिक, adj., i. e. साहस + इक,
 I. adj., f. की.
 1. Using force or violence, Man. 3, 344.
 2. Rapacious.
 3. Cruel, Mālat. 9, 5.
 4. Inflicted as punishment.
 5. Perpetrated by violence.
 6. Bold, daring.
 7. Rash, Mālat. 64, 4; [] impetuous.
 II. m. A robber, Pañc. i. d. 390.
 --Comp.
साहसिकता साहसिक + ता, f. in महा-, Great boldness, Pañc. 129, 22.

साहित्य साहित्य, i. e. सहित + य,
 I. n., and f. हिति, Society, connexion, combination.
 II. n. Poetry, Böhtl. Ind. Spr. 3250.

साह्वय साह्वय, i. e. स-आह्वय, m. Fighting animals for sport or money.
 --Cf. आह्वय.
स-हर्ष + म् स-हर्ष + म्, adv. cheerfully, Vikr. 6, 1.
स- + हार्द स- + हार्द, adj. affectionate, tender, Śiś. 9, 69.
स-हुड स-हुड, adj., f. डा, MBh. 3, 640, with rams (for fighting ?).

स- + हृदय स- + हृदय,
 I. adj. 1. along with the heart, Vikr. 71, 13. 2. compassionate, Rām. 2, 13, 16.
 II. m. a wise man, Böhtl. Ind. Spr. 1265.
स- + हेतुक स- + हेतुक, adj. 1. produced by a cause, Bhāṣāp. 100. 2. with the motive, Rājat. 5, 54 (Śūra knowing that he had retired, and also his motive for it).
स- + हेला स- + हेला, adj. sportive.
